{{Quote|We anticipate that when the Yuuzhan Vong commander at Mon Calamari learns that Coruscant is under siege, he will attempt to jump some of his battle groups back to the Core, by way of Toong'l and Caluula, trusting the yammosks installed on those worlds to coordinate withdrawal and protect against the possibility of ambush.|[[Traest Kre'fey]]|<ref name="TUF" />}}
'''Toong'l''',<ref name="ItWoSW:EPI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> also known as '''Toong'L''',<ref name="AA" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Toong'l system/Legends|Toong'l system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] species.

==History==
{{Quote|Lastly, Toong'l Security Systems was destroyed when its planet was struck by a comet.|[[Kosta]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="TH">''[[The Hive]]''</ref>}}
The planet was hit by two comets in [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]], and many of the survivors relocated to [[Tund/Legends|Tund]] and other planets. Others chose to rebuild on their homeworld under King [[Kikipi]].

The planet was the headquarters of [[Toong'l Security Systems]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Toong'l|established]] a [[yammosk]] outpost on the planet, in preparation for the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Defense of Mon Calamari]].<ref name="TUF" />
